f.title: Inform the Ministry immediately of adverse reactions (RIS Art. 38)
f.statement: Adverse reactions to medicines or other health supplies that occur during their marketing or use, those notified by health professionals, those published in the scientific literature and those reported by international health organisations shall be made known immediately to the Ministry of Health (Secretaría) by the registration holder, or by the distributors or marketers of the supplies.
f.applicability: Adverse reactions arising during marketing or use, notified by health professionals, published in the scientific literature, or reported by international health organisations.
f.processes: Submission operations; Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Registration holder; distributors or marketers of the health supplies
rows.quote:
ARTÍCULO 38. Las reacciones adversas de los medicamentos u otros Insumos que se pre-
senten durante la comercialización o uso de éstos, las notiﬁcadas por los profesionales de la
salud, las publicadas en la literatura cientíﬁca y las reportadas por los organismos sanitarios
internacionales, deberán hacerse del conocimiento inmediato de la Secretaría por el titu-
lar del registro, por los distribuidores o comercializadores de los Insumos.
rows.review_note: Review: added. The guide reproduces RIS Art. 38 in full as applicable law; it carries a complete duty (actors, sources, 'inmediato' timing), not a bare cross-reference, so it gets a row with norm Regulation. Quote re-cut at full article; line-end hyphens 'pre-/senten' and 'titu-/lar' are inside the quote as in the text (checker squashes them). LGS Art. 58 V bis is only a heading fragment: no row. Translation check: own translation (deberán = shall). Double-check: Translation verified (quote_en faithful; level follows the Spanish modal). Kept as a row only so an admin can decide: the guide reproduces RIS Art. 38 verbatim under "Normatividad aplicable" and adds no duty of its own; the same article is curated in the separately loaded RIS file (MX-RIS-0002). Duplicate of the source law, below 90; recommend reject. Quote also has line-end hyphen splits from the PDF layout.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 38. Adverse reactions to medicines or other Supplies that arise during their marketing or use, those notified by health professionals, those published in the scientific literature and those reported by international health organisations shall be made known immediately to the Ministry by the registration holder, or by the distributors or marketers of the Supplies.

f.title: Code the reported clinical manifestation with the current MedDRA version
f.statement: Health professionals, sanitary registration holders or their legal representatives, institutions or establishments that intend to conduct or conduct research in human beings, and distributors/marketers shall code the clinical manifestation reported in their notifications using the current MedDRA terminology.
f.clause: Desarrollo: ¿Cuál es la Norma Oficial Mexicana que habla sobre la farmacovigilancia en México? (NOM-220-SSA1-2016)

rows.actor: Health professionals, registration holders or their legal representatives, research institutions/establishments, distributors/marketers
rows.quote:
Las notiﬁcaciones provenientes de los profesionales
de la salud, titulares de registro sanitario o sus
representantes legales, instituciones o establecimientos
que pretendan o realicen investigación en
seres humanos y distribuidores/comercializadores,
deberán realizar la codiﬁcación de la manifestación
clínica reportada en la notiﬁcación, utilizando
la terminología MedDRA vigente.
rows.location: Desarrollo: ¿Cuál es la Norma Oficial Mexicana que habla sobre la farmacovigilancia en México? (NOM-220-SSA1-2016)
rows.review_note: Review: statement reworded so the notifiers (not the notifications) carry the duty; legal_basis NOM-220-SSA1-2016 (passage is the guide's answer on NOM-220). Same sentence repeated under 'Notificación' (p.11): no separate row. Translation check: agrees (deberán = shall). Double-check: Translation verified (quote_en faithful; level follows the Spanish modal). Restates NOM-220-SSA1-2016 text that is curated separately (COFEPRIS-NOM220-2016-0036); publishing this row too would duplicate the library requirement, so it stays a draft for an admin to reject or link. Otherwise the quote proves actor, deberán and the MedDRA duty.
rows.quote_en: Notifications from health professionals, holders of sanitary registration or their legal representatives, institutions or establishments that intend to conduct or conduct research in human beings, and distributors/marketers shall code the clinical manifestation reported in the notification using the current MedDRA terminology.

f.title: Submit each case complete and structured with current ICH E2B data elements
f.statement: For an adequate causality analysis, the information of each notified case must be submitted completely and in a structured way, covering the elements required by the current ICH E2B.
f.clause: Desarrollo: ¿Cuál es la Norma Oficial Mexicana que habla sobre la farmacovigilancia en México? (NOM-220-SSA1-2016)

rows.actor: Health professionals, registration holders or their legal representatives, research institutions/establishments, distributors/marketers
rows.quote:
Para realizar un adecuado análisis de causalidad,
es necesario que la información de cada caso
notiﬁcado sea sometida de forma completa y
estructurada, contemplando los elementos
requeridos por las ICH-E2B vigente.
rows.location: Desarrollo: ¿Cuál es la Norma Oficial Mexicana que habla sobre la farmacovigilancia en México? (NOM-220-SSA1-2016)
rows.review_note: Review: level kept Mandatory: 'es necesario que ... sea sometida' states a requirement for submitted cases (restating NOM-220 content, applied as required, like 必要がある under the Japanese ruling); it is not 'se recomienda'/'debería'. legal_basis NOM-220-SSA1-2016. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified (quote_en faithful; level follows the Spanish modal). Level is a judgement call: "es necesario que ... sea sometida" carries no deberá; Mandatory kept because the guide restates a NOM-220 content requirement, but the Japanese 必要 ruling does not govern Spanish text. Actor is not in the quote (inferred from 0001). Restates NOM-220-SSA1-2016 text that is curated separately (COFEPRIS-NOM220-2016-0047); publishing this row too would duplicate the library requirement, so it stays a draft for an admin to reject or link.
rows.quote_en: To carry out an adequate causality analysis, it is necessary that the information of each notified case be submitted completely and in a structured way, covering the elements required by the current ICH-E2B.

f.title: Case information may be repeated in the narrative section
f.statement: Submitting the structured E2B elements implies that the information may be repeated in the narrative section.
f.clause: Desarrollo: ¿Cuál es la Norma Oficial Mexicana que habla sobre la farmacovigilancia en México? (NOM-220-SSA1-2016)

rows.actor: Health professionals, registration holders or their legal representatives, research institutions/establishments, distributors/marketers
rows.quote:
Esto implica
que la información puede repetirse en la sección
narrativa.
rows.location: Desarrollo: ¿Cuál es la Norma Oficial Mexicana que habla sobre la farmacovigilancia en México? (NOM-220-SSA1-2016)
rows.review_note: Review: legal_basis NOM-220-SSA1-2016. Translation check: agrees (puede = may, Permitted). Double-check: Translation verified (quote_en faithful; level follows the Spanish modal). rows.quote_en: This implies that the information may be repeated in the narrative section.

f.title: Clinical manifestation information must follow the current MedDRA terminology
f.statement: The information on clinical manifestations shall adhere to the current MedDRA terminology.
f.clause: Desarrollo: ¿Cuál es la Norma Oficial Mexicana que habla sobre la farmacovigilancia en México? (NOM-220-SSA1-2016)

rows.actor: Health professionals, registration holders or their legal representatives, research institutions/establishments, distributors/marketers
rows.quote:
Además, la información de las
manifestaciones clínicas deberá estar apegada
a la terminología MedDRA vigente.
rows.location: Desarrollo: ¿Cuál es la Norma Oficial Mexicana que habla sobre la farmacovigilancia en México? (NOM-220-SSA1-2016)
rows.review_note: Review: legal_basis NOM-220-SSA1-2016. Close to 0001 but a separate sentence on the content of submitted case information; kept. Translation check: agrees (deberá = shall). rows.quote_en: In addition, the information on the clinical manifestations shall adhere to the current MedDRA terminology.

f.title: Patient/consumer reports do not require MedDRA; as much reaction information as possible is desirable
f.statement: Notifications from patients/consumers do not require the use of MedDRA terminology; it is desirable to have as much information as possible about the notified reaction.
f.clause: Desarrollo: ¿Si soy paciente también debo utilizar la terminología MedDRA?
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote:
Las notiﬁcaciones provenientes de pacientes/consumidores
                                            no requerirán el uso de la terminología MedDRA; es
                                            deseable contar con la mayor cantidad posible de
                                            información sobre la reacción notiﬁcada.
rows.location: Desarrollo: ¿Si soy paciente también debo utilizar la terminología MedDRA?
rows.review_note: Review: legal_basis NOM-220-SSA1-2016 ('La NOM establece'); lifecycle Both (patient reports are not limited to marketed products in the quote). Level Permitted from 'no requerirán' (headline rule); 'es deseable' part is a recommendation kept in the same row. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified (quote_en faithful; level follows the Spanish modal). Quote is introduced by "La NOM establece lo siguiente": a NOM-220 restatement. Row mixes a permission (no MedDRA needed) with an "es deseable" recommendation under one Permitted level. Restates NOM-220-SSA1-2016 text that is curated separately (NOM-220 8.1.10); publishing this row too would duplicate the library requirement, so it stays a draft for an admin to reject or link.
rows.quote_en: Notifications from patients/consumers will not require the use of MedDRA terminology; it is desirable to have as much information as possible about the notified reaction.

f.title: Hold a valid MedDRA licence to code adverse reactions in e-Reporting Industria
f.statement: A communication of the National Pharmacovigilance Centre to the pharmaceutical industry published on 2 May 2022 states that the pharmaceutical industry must have a valid MedDRA licence in order to code adverse reactions and other information in e-Reporting Industria.
f.clause: Notificación: Comunicado del Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia a la industria farmacéutica (2 May 2022)

rows.quote:
El 02 de mayo de 2022 se publicó un comunicado del Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia a
   la industria farmacéutica relacionado con MedDRA como estándar de codiﬁcación en
   e-Reporting industria, donde se indica que la industria farmacéutica debe contar con una
   licencia MedDRA válida para poder codiﬁcar las reacciones adversas y demás información en
   e-Reporting Industria.
rows.location: Notificación: Comunicado del Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia a la industria farmacéutica (2 May 2022)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees (debe = must). Double-check: Translation verified (quote_en faithful; level follows the Spanish modal). The duty is reported second-hand from the CNFV communiqué of 2 May 2022 (the guide says "se indica que"); the communiqué itself is the primary source. Quote otherwise proves actor, debe and scope.
rows.quote_en: On 2 May 2022 a communication from the National Pharmacovigilance Centre to the pharmaceutical industry was published relating to MedDRA as the coding standard in e-Reporting Industria, which states that the pharmaceutical industry must have a valid MedDRA licence in order to be able to code adverse reactions and other information in e-Reporting Industria.

f.title: List all related MedDRA terms for each important risk in the risk management plan
f.statement: In the safety specification of a risk management plan, for each important identified and potential risk, the associated MedDRA terminology is to be given: all MedDRA terms related to the risk shall be mentioned.
f.clause: Planes de manejo de riesgos: Especificaciones de seguridad, riesgos importantes identificados y potenciales, item 14
f.applicability: Risk management plans (Guía de farmacovigilancia para la elaboración de Planes de Manejo de Riesgos), important identified and potential risks.

rows.quote:
14. Terminología MedDRA asociada. Mencionar todos los términos MedDRA relacionados
con el riesgo.
rows.location: Planes de manejo de riesgos: Especificaciones de seguridad, riesgos importantes identificados y potenciales, item 14
rows.review_note: Review: level kept Mandatory: 'Mencionar todos los términos...' is an infinitive instruction in the required content list of the RMP safety specification (template field 14), i.e. a content requirement, not a 'se recomienda'. Actor (registration holder) comes from the RMP guide's scope, not the quote. Statement tightened. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified (quote_en faithful; level follows the Spanish modal). Level is a judgement call: an infinitive item ("Mencionar") in a template content list from the RMP guide, no modal verb; table/list-derived content. Actor (registration holder) and "for each important identified and potential risk" come from headings outside the quote. The RMP guide is curated separately (cat-mx-guia-pmr-2025), so this may duplicate it.
rows.quote_en: 14. Associated MedDRA terminology. Mention all the MedDRA terms related to the risk.

f.title: Activate the MedDRA licence through the API in e-Reporting Industria
f.statement: A MedDRA licence is a requirement for access to e-Reporting Industria: the licence must be activated through an API integrated in e-Reporting Industria to be able to use MedDRA terminology in the manual upload module.
f.systems: MedDRA; e-Reporting Industria; MedDRA licence API

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical industry users of e-Reporting Industria
rows.quote:
¿Es requisito contar con licencia MedDRA para tener acceso a e-Reporting
Industria?

Si, la licencia debe activarse a través de una API que está integrada e e-Reporting Industria
para poder utilizar la terminología MedDRA dentro del módulo de carga manual.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees (debe activarse = must be activated). Double-check: Translation verified (quote_en faithful; level follows the Spanish modal). Actor (industry users of e-Reporting Industria) is inferred from the system name; the FAQ answer "Si, ... debe activarse" proves the duty itself.
rows.quote_en:
Is it a requirement to have a MedDRA licence to have access to e-Reporting Industria?

Yes, the licence must be activated through an API that is integrated in e-Reporting Industria in order to be able to use the MedDRA terminology within the manual upload module.

f.title: Use e-Reporting Industria as the only valid tool for industry notification
f.statement: The only valid tool for industry notification is e-Reporting Industria.

rows.quote:
La única herramienta válida para la notiﬁcación de industria es mediante eReporting
Industria.
rows.review_note: Review: kept separate from 0010 (not merged): this is the channel rule (e-Reporting Industria only), 0010 is the licence-planning duty; the sentence also opens 0010's quote because it is the FAQ's reason why a licence is needed even without cases. Level Mandatory: 'única herramienta válida' excludes any other channel. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified (quote_en faithful; level follows the Spanish modal). Level Mandatory rests on "la única herramienta válida", not a modal verb (judgement call); actor inferred from "notificación de industria". Overlap with 0010: the same sentence opens 0010's quote; 0009 owns the channel rule and 0010's statement was trimmed so it no longer restates it as its own duty.
rows.quote_en: The only valid tool for industry notification is through eReporting Industria.

f.title: Hold a MedDRA licence even before any report is received, anticipating purchase and annual renewals
f.statement: A sanitary registration holder/legal representative whose pharmacovigilance unit (UFV) has not yet received any notification is told, in answer to whether it must have a MedDRA licence, that e-Reporting Industria is the only valid tool for industry notification (see the channel rule in the separate row); it must consider the time its company needs to provide the funds to acquire the licence, and so must anticipate the licence request and the annual renewals.
f.applicability: Including registration holders/legal representatives whose UFV has not yet received any notification.

rows.deadline: In advance of need; renewals are annual
rows.quote:
Si soy titular de registro sanitarios/representante legal, pero hasta el momento no
he recibido alguna notiﬁcación en mi UFV, ¿debo tener licencia MedDRA?

La única herramienta válida para la notiﬁcación de industria es mediante eReporting
Industria. Se debe considerar el tiempo que le toma a su empresa proporcionar el recurso
económico para la adquisición de la licencia, por lo que debe anticiparse la solicitud y las
renovaciones anuales.
rows.review_note: Review: overlap with 0009 decided: not merged (different duties); statement now states the licence duty for holders without cases and the reason, and leaves the channel rule to 0009. Title re-cut. Translation check: agrees (se debe considerar / debe anticiparse = must). Double-check: Translation verified (quote_en faithful; level follows the Spanish modal). The FAQ answer never says "sí, debe tener licencia": the licence duty for holders without cases is inferred from the channel sentence (0009) and the instruction to anticipate funding and renewals. Statement trimmed to the anticipation duty and the reason, leaving the channel rule to 0009; quote overlaps 0009 by one sentence.
rows.quote_en:
If I am a holder of sanitary registrations/legal representative but so far have not received any notification in my UFV, must I have a MedDRA licence?

The only valid tool for industry notification is through eReporting Industria. The time it takes your company to provide the financial resources to acquire the licence must be considered, so the request and the annual renewals must be anticipated.

f.title: A corporate MedDRA licence covers the Mexican affiliate
f.statement: A Mexican affiliate whose corporate headquarters in another country holds a MedDRA licence does not need its own: the corporate licence covers all affiliates in the other countries; MSSO help desk can be contacted for details.
f.applicability: Affiliates in Mexico whose corporate group holds a MedDRA licence.

rows.quote:
Mi corporativo que se encuentra otro país cuenta con licencia ¿la ﬁlial en México
debe tener la propia?

No es necesario, la licencia corporativa cubre a todas las ﬁliales en los demás países. Puede
contactar directamente al servicio de asistencia de MSSO para mayores detalles.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Level Permitted ('No es necesario' = not necessary; 'Puede contactar' = may). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified (quote_en faithful; level follows the Spanish modal). Quote proves the whole statement: "No es necesario" (= Permitted, not necessary) and "Puede contactar"; domestic/foreign wording (affiliate in Mexico, corporate in another country) is the quote's own.
rows.quote_en:
My corporate headquarters, located in another country, has a licence: must the affiliate in Mexico have its own?

It is not necessary; the corporate licence covers all affiliates in the other countries. You may contact the MSSO help desk directly for further details.
